title: Keep command and Naam in one breath
summary: The Guru's command is kept truly when obedience carries Naam inside it. Keep the command with Naam inside it.
takeaway: Keep the command with Naam inside it.
lifeApplication: At the threshold of the next task, obey with the whole mind and carry Naam inwardly instead of calling attention to the act.

source.shortMeaning: The Guru's command is kept truly when obedience carries Naam inside it.
source.lifeApplication: Before the next task or seva, stop at the threshold and bring the mind into it.
